Happy Birthday
Luna
My dearest Luna,
I know this birthday message comes a little late — but know that not a single day passed where I didn't think of you. You deserve every wish, every song, every candle.

I want you to know, from the very bottom of my heart — I love you. Not just on birthdays, not just when things are easy, but every single day, in every quiet and loud moment.

No matter what life brings — the storms, the hard nights, the moments when the world feels too heavy — I will always be here for you. You will never have to face anything alone. My hand will always find yours.

You are my moon, my light, my favorite reason to smile. Happy (belated) birthday, Luna. May this year be as beautiful, as rare, and as magical as you are. 🌙
Forever yours ✦
with all the love the stars can hold
Count On Me
Bruno Mars
